graph_source: GDELT 2.0 Global Knowledge Graph events (news-derived event graph)
domain: news-derived event graph (who did what to whom, where, when)
headline: +22.1 AUC pts vs baseline JEPA; behind supervised GAT and GCN
honest_assessment: GDELT lacks the physical-cluster structure of the semiconductor graph; the topological-module vocabulary (H0/H1/H2) is a weaker match to its geometry. GAT and GCN outperform Crystara here by a real margin.
